licences.author: G. Schirmer, piano reduction as printed
licences.notes: Written out from the printed pages: the sung lines and the piano each read by two independent readers, every disagreement settled on the page by a judge, then checked bar by bar and checked again by a fresh checker (clean). The English singing translation and the stage directions are left out. Andante 2/4 in bars 1–49, Allegro 6/8 from bar 50: the print's one-eighth upbeat to the Allegro ("An-") is kept as its own short bar 50, and in bar 49 the voices, printed with only three eighths, are completed with an unprinted eighth rest. Playback tempo: Andante ♩ = 43 and Allegro ♩. ≈ 57 (♩ = 86), about 3:26 in all, from the median of five complete recordings (Fricsay 1958 3:13, Giulini 1959 3:12, Böhm 1977 3:40, Haitink 1984 3:33, Karajan 1985 3:27; median 3:27). The tracks are not split at the Allegro, so the two sections keep a set proportion: the Allegro's eighth note moves at the speed of the Andante's sixteenth. Mozart gives the words Andante and Allegro only.
